instruction: Candid corporate photograph, medium wide shot. In a bright office meeting room with white curtains and background shelves, four colleagues sit around a white table. The woman in the black blazer (R1) and the curly-haired man in the black blazer (R3) high-five in the center, with the woman holding papers. The man in the pinstripe suit (R4) on the far left and the gray-haired man in the gray suit (R2) on the far right watch them happily. Bright, even lighting fills the professional space.
